description: Discover public curated Placelists (venue collections) on FairWhere. Returns id, slug, name, description, best_for, categories, venue count, and canonical URLs. Call this before fair_shortlist. If count is 0 for an activity, that activity is unavailable: refuse to invent restaurants/cocktails and pivot to available_activities.

activity.description: Activity or synonym (drinks/pubs → pub lists; padel/tennis/squash → sport lists). May return zero: pivot using available_activities.

city.description: City whose public Placelists to list.

query.description: Optional free-text filter matched against Placelist name, description, best_for, and intent tags.

name: list_placelists
title: List FairWhere Placelists
